name: ChapterPage - Forming Chapter
description: The same chapter page with status forming — the state DC and Seattle are in. The leads block is replaced by a help-lead-it band, the hero kicker reads Chapter - Forming, and callouts carry what the chapter can honestly claim. The fixture deliberately PASSES a lead named Should Not Render: a forming chapter must suppress its leads rather than merely lack them, and a fixture with no leads could not tell the difference. Compare with ChapterPage - Full Chapter for the active shape.
